documentation.content: Someone used "Report this recipe" (`recipe_reported`: `reason`, `kind`, `snapshot`, `hasNote`, `pictures`, `imageLevel`, `platform`, `appVersion`, `language`, `uidHash`; `report` is a hash of the report id; never the note or the recipe). Read the report in the Firestore console under `reports/` (search by time and reason). See functions/README.md, "Reports" and "Alerts".
